rules.description: Saving shows 'Saved.'; the saved name and address become the account's from then on, including the starting address of the next checkout.
rules.expected: Shows 'Saved.' and the saved values are used everywhere after.

rules.description: Product page allows adding the product to the cart with a quantity
rules.expected: Quantity is entered and the item is added to the cart

rules.description: Request bodies larger than 64 KB are ignored.
rules.expected: Bodies over 64 KB are ignored.

rules.description: Each customer has one cart that starts empty.
rules.expected: One cart per customer, starting empty.

rules.description: An order is Placed, Paid, Shipped or Cancelled; a new order is Placed.
rules.expected: Order status is one of Placed, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled; new orders start as Placed.

rules.description: Review step requires a delivery address in the current checkout.
rules.expected: A customer who opens the review step before giving a delivery address in the current checkout is sent to step 1.

rules.description: Discount code form and Check out button appear only with at least one cart line.
rules.expected: They are shown only when the cart has at least one line.

rules.description: Free shipping on orders of $50.00 or more is stated on the product list.
rules.expected: The product list states that shipping is free on orders of $50.00 or more.

rules.description: The email address must be valid.
rules.expected: Anything other than a valid email address is refused with "Enter a valid email address."

rules.description: Email addresses are not case-sensitive and surrounding spaces are ignored.
rules.expected: Email addresses are matched ignoring letter case and surrounding spaces, when registering and signing in.

rules.description: Placing an order turns the cart into the order; afterwards the cart is empty and the next checkout starts at step 1.
rules.expected: The cart is empty and the next checkout starts again at step 1.

rules.description: Email address must include an @ sign
rules.expected: Form rejects an email address without an @

rules.description: A product that does not exist is reported as not found.
rules.expected: Shows "Product not found" (page and API: 404).

rules.description: A Cancelled order cannot be cancelled again.
rules.expected: Cancelling a Cancelled order is refused (API 409).

rules.description: Price display format.
rules.expected: Prices are shown in dollars with two decimals; the API gives every amount in cents.

rules.description: A customer can cancel an order until it ships; cancelling makes it Cancelled.
rules.expected: A Shipped order cannot be cancelled (API 409).

rules.description: The password must have at least 8 characters.
rules.expected: A shorter password is refused with a message that states the minimum.

rules.description: Cart total calculation.
rules.expected: The total is the subtotal minus the discount plus the shipping charge.

rules.description: Maximum of 10 of each item in the cart.
rules.expected: A change making an item's quantity more than 10 is refused with "You can order up to 10 of each item." and the cart stays as it was.

rules.description: User can edit name and default delivery address on the account page
rules.expected: Name and default delivery address are editable by the user

rules.description: Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal reaches $50.00.
rules.expected: Shipping is free when the subtotal after the discount is $50.00 or more.

rules.description: Placing an order with an empty cart is refused.
rules.expected: Refused with 'Your cart is empty.' (API 409).

rules.description: The Orders page lists all of the customer's orders, newest first, each with its number, date, status and total.
rules.expected: Orders are listed newest first with number, date, status and total.

rules.description: Customers can see only their own orders.
rules.expected: Other order numbers show 'Order not found' (page and API 404).

rules.description: A new account is signed in straight away.
rules.expected: A new account is signed in immediately and has no default delivery address yet.

rules.description: Wrong email and password combination is refused at sign-in.
rules.expected: A wrong combination is refused with "Email or password is wrong." (API: 401).

rules.description: An order page shows the order's status, lines, total and delivery address.
rules.expected: The order page shows status, lines, total and delivery address.

rules.description: Adding a product already in the cart increases that line's quantity.
rules.expected: The line's quantity increases by the quantity added.

rules.description: An order needs a delivery address given in step 1 of the current checkout; without one, placing the order is refused.
rules.expected: Placing an order without a delivery address is refused with 'Add a delivery address first.' (API 409).

rules.description: The review step shows the delivery address, the cart with its prices, and a Place order button.
rules.expected: The review step shows the delivery address, the cart with its prices, and a Place order button.

rules.description: The email address the customer signs in with cannot be changed.
rules.expected: The Account page shows the email address, which cannot be changed.

rules.description: An order keeps a copy of the cart's lines, subtotal, discount, shipping charge, total, delivery address and time placed, and gets a number of the form ord-NNNN.
rules.expected: Each order stores a copy of these values and a number of the form ord-NNNN.

rules.description: Product list notes a shipping threshold alongside prices
rules.expected: Shipping threshold note is shown with product prices

rules.description: Discount codes are case-insensitive and ignore surrounding spaces.
rules.expected: Accepted in any letter case with spaces around them; unknown code refused with "That code is not valid." (API: 400).

rules.description: Cart subtotal is the sum of line totals.
rules.expected: The subtotal equals the sum of its line totals.

rules.description: After placing an order the customer sees the new order's page.
rules.expected: The customer is shown the new order's page.

rules.description: Signing out ends the session.
rules.expected: After signing out the person is a visitor again.

rules.description: Only a Placed order can be paid; paying makes it Paid.
rules.expected: Paying a non-Placed order is refused (API 409).

rules.description: Cart page shows the signed-in user's cart contents
rules.expected: Cart contents are shown to the signed-in user

rules.description: On the Account page the customer can change name and default delivery address; the name is required.
rules.expected: Saving requires a name.

rules.description: A visitor on a product page is invited to sign in to buy.
rules.expected: A visitor sees an invitation to sign in to buy.

rules.description: Cart, checkout, orders and account pages are for signed-in customers.
rules.expected: A visitor who opens one is taken to the sign-in page and, after signing in, back to the page they asked for.

rules.description: Order can be cancelled before shipment
rules.expected: Cancel order is allowed before shipment

rules.description: Anyone can browse the product list and product pages without signing in.
rules.expected: Visitors can view the product list and every product page.

rules.description: SAVE10 takes 10% off the order subtotal.
rules.expected: 10% off the subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent.

rules.description: A quantity must be a whole number of at least 1.
rules.expected: Anything else is refused with "Choose a quantity of at least 1."

rules.description: A delivery address needs at least 5 characters.
rules.expected: A shorter address is refused with "Enter a delivery address."

rules.description: Shipping costs $5.00 per order.
rules.expected: Shipping charge is $5.00 per order.

rules.description: The name is required on registration.
rules.expected: An empty name is refused with "Enter your name."

rules.description: An empty cart has no shipping charge.
rules.expected: Empty cart shipping charge is zero.

rules.description: An email address can belong to one account only.
rules.expected: Registering again with the same email address is refused (API: 409).

rules.description: A customer without orders sees a 'No orders yet.' message.
rules.expected: Shows 'No orders yet.'
